entries.mitigation: Interrupt Sithera immediately when she channels so the damage increase never completes.
Keep Khephidaen inside the active light and plan positioning before braziers extinguish; the fight becomes needlessly messy if the boss is dragged into darkness.
Interrupt the feeding channel immediately so the Votary cannot rapidly heal from dead spiders.
Use the center of the arena and move completely outside the growing blast before it detonates.
Keep clear of the poison pools and preserve an escape lane for the expanding blast.
Kill all three shadow copies and collect the red essence orbs they leave behind to end Dranos's immunity.
Move out of the first impact and watch the split follow-up paths instead of immediately stepping back into them.

entries.entry_name: Shadow Sense — Velidreth the Lady of Lace
entries.mitigation: Stop moving while Velidreth hunts from the ceiling, then dodge only when she commits to the drop.

entries.entry_name: Devour — Velidreth the Lady of Lace
entries.mitigation: Use ultimates regularly rather than hoarding a large pool that Velidreth can drain.

entries.entry_name: Venom Sacs — Velidreth the Lady of Lace
entries.mitigation: Avoid venom-sac impacts and leave enough room for the group to move cleanly through later overlaps.
Block the thrown rocks to avoid the heavy damage and knockdown.
Move out of Zatzu's telegraphed landing area before the leap connects.
The targeted player lines Chudan up with the electricity dome or shielded target and lets his charge break it.
Block the projectile without abandoning the planned charge alignment.
Carry the green spice to a geyser to cleanse it and remove Xal-Nur's immunity or enrage before resuming damage.
Release the Wamasu deliberately when needed to reduce ranged pressure rather than leaving the group buried under archers.
Dodge the charge and keep its path clear of teammates.
Destroy priority totems immediately before their effects compound the encounter.

entries.entry_name: Hist Sap / Statue Reveal — Tree-Minder Na-Kesh
entries.mitigation: Unaffected players reveal the correct statue; the blinded player uses the temporary sap skill on that statue to free themselves.
Control the amber before an add can claim it and gain empowerment.
Avoid amber impacts and preserve enough spacing that the group retains safe movement space.
